svg.title: Two cross-sections of the wafer, one above the other. Before the step three blocks of resist stand on a thin purple film over a flat surface with three metal plugs. After it the film is gone wherever the resist was open and the resist is gone too, leaving three thin purple pads, one on each plug, on the flat oxide; the right-hand one runs on over the gate.
svg.desc: Two cross-sections of the wafer, one above the other. Before the step three blocks of resist stand on a thin purple film over a flat surface with three metal plugs. After it the film is gone wherever the resist was open and the resist is gone too, leaving three thin purple pads, one on each plug, on the flat oxide; the right-hand one runs on over the gate.
svg.text: Before: resist over a pad on each plug (step 102)
The titanium nitride is plasma-etched where
the resist is open; the resist is then stripped.
After: TiN pads on the plugs, the resist stripped
Not to scale. Thin films are drawn thicker than they are.
